advance.road_type_text: Speed 65 mph, road_type = 'rural' -> Table 6B-1 category: rural

buffer.lookup_text: CDOT supplement: 570 ft. MUTCD Table 6B-2: 645 ft. Plan uses CDOT supplement value. Note: CDOT supplement permits shorter buffer than federal table. Verify against project-specific engineering judgment.
buffer.source: CDOT S-630-1 Standard Plan, Sheet 14 (Case 26 at 65 mph). MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (federal baseline).

case.case: Case 26 at 65 mph: Shoulder closure with reduced work-zone speed
case.narrative: This scenario matches CDOT Standard Plan S-630-1 shoulder closure typical applications with a reduced work-zone posted speed (Cases 26/27, Sheet 14). Posted speed reduced from 65 → 60 mph; Fines Double envelope applies per S-630-1 Sheet 12, Fines Double Signing Notes.
case.narrative_2: The generated plan follows the same device layout as the reference case with spacing computed for 65 mph.
case.trigger_condition: WHEN HAZARDS (WORKERS, EQUIPMENT, OR TEMPORARY BARRIER) ARE WITHIN 8 FT OF TRAVEL WAY

checks.detail: Required: True. Signs placed: 16 left, 16 right.
checks.label: Signs on both sides of divided highway
G20-5P Work Zone signs every 2,640 ft

checks.detail: Work-zone speed reduced 65 → 60 mph (Δ5 mph). Required: 1. Placed: 1.
checks.label: Speed reduction <= 15 mph per sign installation

fines_double.citation: CDOT S-630-1 (July 2026) Sheet 12, Fines Double Signing Notes

operational_notes.action: Install Fines Double signs no more than 4 hours before the start of the work day. Do not leave signs up overnight when work is not active.
Remove or cover Fines Double signs when work concludes; doubled fines apply only when workers or work activity are present in the zone.
Relocate the R2-10/R2-11 envelope to follow the actual work area as the project progresses; do not leave Fines Double signs in place beyond the active work zone.
Maintain a 250 ft minimum spacing between Fines Double signs (R2-10, R2-11, G20-5P/R2-6P assemblies) and other warning or regulatory signs. Engineer may adjust placement to satisfy this minimum.

flagger.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Chapter 6D (Flagger Control) and Chapter 6E (One-Lane, Two-Way Traffic Control).

spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 17 tangent + 2 downstream = 19 cones total
spacing.in_taper_text: 65 mph -> 65 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 65 mph -> 130 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.tangent_count_text: 2000 ft / 130 ft max spacing -> 17 cones at 125.0 ft intervals
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 217 ft / 65 ft max spacing -> 5 drums at 54.2 ft intervals

taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 26 (shoulder closure on freeway/expressway, 65 mph posted with reduced work-zone speed; Sheet 14)
taper.formula_choice: Speed 65 mph >= 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
